resolvedFinding.issue: Parsed entries were shallow-frozen and exposed to storedPath and verifyIntegrity hooks, permitting retained mutable views across chunks.
resolvedFinding.resolution: Initial parse validates canonical depth/node/byte budgets, then deepFreeze(entries) freezes rows and lineage. RetainingStore regression checks both hooks, failed Reflect.set mutations and equal repeated chunk results.

reviewedContracts: Every scoped read opens a new initial index snapshot; no snapshot persists into a later adapter load.
Every chunk and final callback return re-run directory, raw descriptor, identity, mutation metadata, bounded bytes and SHA-256 checks before accepting reuse.
Index path/descriptor stat comparisons retain bigint device/inode and nanosecond mutation fields; captured physical identity and containment remain enforced.
Only matching freshly read bytes reuse immutable parse and id/digest lookup maps; duplicate matches are retained rather than overwritten.
Envelope signatures, current authority, payload bytes and integrity remain individually reauthenticated; no authority or payload cache is introduced.
Existing item-release and end-of-chunk decision lease barriers remain; no lease duration is extended.
Captured chunk capability closes in finally after success, throw, promise or thenable rejection; unbranded resolver capture is rejected.
Per-chunk and legacy batch admission remains 128; the scoped window caps attempted requests at 10000.
RunAdapter checks frontiers around recovery, resolves in 128-item chunks, and only reclassifies artifact failure as conflict after successful fresh frontier verification establishes change.

Windows secure/local-UI root preparation creates independent empty roots, batches root ACL verification before descendants, binds ordered results and exact before/after dev/ino/birthtimeNs, then creates children.
Root ACL failure or identity replacement fails before child directories or ledger objects; non-Windows/general paths do not acquire a permission bypass.

limits: Source review does not establish performance improvement or late-turn timeout resolution.
